question.text: Operating expenses in PMS are capped at:

explanation.text: The Logic: SEBI: op-expenses capped at 0.50% per annum of daily average AUM (excluding brokerage/STT/etc which are pass-through). The Trap: The 2% figure is a management-fee ballpark; 0.50% is specifically op-expenses. Cross-Exam Context: XXI-A. Manager's Pro-Tip: Break fees clearly in reports: management + performance + operating + brokerage — each line-item visible to client.
